text:
```yaml
name: Docker Build and Test

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'build/docker/**'
      - '.github/workflows/docker-build-test.yml'

jobs:
  build-and-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up Docker Buildx
      uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v1

    - name: Login to Docker Hub
      uses: docker/login-action@v1
      with:
        username: ${{ secrets.DOCKER_USERNAME }}
        password: ${{ secrets.DOCKER_PASSWORD }}

    - name: Build and test Docker image
      id: build
      uses: docker/build-push-action@v6
      with:
        context: ./build/docker
        file: ./build/docker/Dockerfile
        target: test
        push: false
        tags: thawn/ttmp32gme:test

    - name: Run tests
      run: |
        docker run --rm thawn/ttmp32gme:test pytest

    - name: Build production Docker image
      if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
      id: build-prod
      uses: docker/build-push-action@v6
      with:
        context: ./build/docker
        file: ./build/docker/Dockerfile
        target: production
        push: true
        tags: thawn/ttmp32gme:${{ github.sha }} thawn/ttmp32gme:v$(date +%Y%m%d%H%M%S)

    - name: Push production image to Docker Hub
      if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
      run: echo "Image pushed to Docker Hub"
```

This workflow is designed to handle both pull requests and pushes to the main branch. It includes steps for building and testing a Docker image using a multi-stage build approach, running tests within the Docker container, and pushing the final production image to Docker Hub when changes are made to the main branch. The workflow is reusable and can be triggered by changes to Docker-related files or the specified workflow file itself.
